name: python-missing-environment
description: A missing project interpreter is reported before blind execution, even when another Python or pytest exists globally. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root outside any SKILL.md-rooted directory and do not create .venv/; the Python test profile must be available.
prompt: Use $kk:test for app.py and tests/test_app.py, following README.md. This is a verification-only run: do not create environments, install packages, edit files, or use a different environment from the documented one. Report any validation gaps.
trap: The model blindly invokes the missing .venv/bin/python, silently switches to global pytest or unittest, or describes unavailable tests as passed.

assertions.text: Agent reads the Python test index, testing.md, and validators.md before attempting validation.
Agent checks whether .venv/bin/python exists and is executable before trying to invoke it; no blind missing-interpreter execution occurs.
Agent reports the documented project environment as unavailable, names the README setup prerequisite, and explicitly states runtime verification is incomplete.
Agent does not substitute a global runner or unittest discovery, install dependencies, create .venv, or modify files. Any independent non-runtime checks are labeled separately.
